report_name: GhostAction Campaign Compromises 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets 30k Repos

threat_actors.name: GhostAction
threat_actors.description: A threat actor group conducting a credential-theft campaign active since at least September 2025. It focuses on compromising the software supply chain by targeting developers' GitHub accounts to steal CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials.
threat_actors.goals: To steal sensitive secrets from CI/CD environments, including cloud provider credentials (e.g., AWS keys), package registry tokens (npm, PyPI), and API keys.

attack_patterns.name: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used stolen credentials, such as GitHub Personal Access Tokens (PATs), to gain unauthorized access to developer accounts.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The campaign leverages compromised developer accounts to abuse the trusted relationship between the developer and their own repositories to inject malicious code.

attack_patterns.name: Compromise Software Supply Chain
attack_patterns.description: The GhostAction campaign compromises the software supply chain by injecting malicious GitHub Actions workflows into over 30,000 software repositories.

attack_patterns.name: Match Legitimate Name or Location
attack_patterns.description: Malicious GitHub Actions workflows were disguised with benign-sounding names like `security-audit.yml` or `github_actions_security.yml` to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The malicious GitHub Actions workflow downloads a script from an attacker-controlled server using `curl`.

attack_patterns.name: Unix Shell
attack_patterns.description: The malicious GitHub Actions workflow executes a downloaded script by piping it directly into a shell like `bash` or `sh`.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials In Files
attack_patterns.description: A malicious script scans the entire Git history of a compromised repository for hardcoded secrets, such as AWS keys and API tokens.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Stolen secrets and environment variables are collected and sent from the GitHub Actions runner to an attacker-controlled server.

campaigns.name: GhostAction
campaigns.description: A large-scale supply chain attack campaign targeting GitHub developer accounts to inject malicious Actions workflows for stealing CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials. The campaign has been active since at least September 2025, with a significant resurgence in October 2026.

identities.name: GitHub
identities.description: The targeted platform where developer accounts were compromised and malicious Actions workflows were injected into repositories.

identities.name: Amazon Web Services
identities.description: A primary target for credential theft, with attackers specifically seeking AWS keys from compromised CI/CD environments.

infrastructure.name: GhostAction Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: An attacker-controlled server used to receive stolen secrets and credentials exfiltrated by the malicious GitHub Actions workflows.

indicators.name: Suspicious GitHub Workflow File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious GitHub Workflow File Creation
id: 2b8c1f9a-6a3d-4e8c-9b1f-7d2e8a1b0c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of GitHub Actions workflow files with names commonly used by the GhostAction campaign.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/ghostaction-compromises-about-1900.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-15
tags:
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1036.005
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains: '.github/workflows/'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - 'security-audit.yml'
      - 'github_actions_security.yml'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of GitHub Actions workflow files with names commonly used by the GhostAction campaign, such as 'security-audit.yml'.

indicators.name: Suspicious Script Execution in GitHub Actions
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Script Execution in GitHub Actions
id: 8e4d2c1b-9a7f-4d3c-8b2a-1f9e7d6c5b4a
status: experimental
description: Detects GitHub Actions steps that pipe scripts downloaded from the internet directly into a shell, a TTP used by the GhostAction campaign.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/ghostaction-compromises-about-1900.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-15
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_pipe:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' | bash'
      - ' | sh'
  selection_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'curl '
      - 'wget '
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects GitHub Actions steps that pipe scripts downloaded from the internet directly into a shell (e.g., `curl ... | bash`), a TTP used by the GhostAction campaign.
